traits.name: brave
traits.reason: Calm, steady tone and exploring edges, but no costly builds were made; mostly moving, gathering and eating, and the one bridge claim is not backed by actions.

traits.name: cheerful
traits.reason: Lines are consistently upbeat with small flourishes like 'Worth every step' and 'Hot bread at dusk, friends', even when no builds were done.
